title: Works of Suetonius
author: Suetonius; Alexander Thomson translation, revised by T. Forester
authorityNotice: Roman biographical and historical works presented as ancient witnesses for historical study, not as equal in authority to Scripture.

works.title: Julius Caesar
works.purpose: To preserve a biographical portrait of Julius Caesar through ancestry, public career, personal habits, virtues, faults, notable sayings, and reported omens as part of Suetonius’s Lives of the Caesars.
